units.source_text: 我阿鼻叫喚[3]地活到今天，在這個人類世界裡，只有、只有這句話是唯一的真理。

en.t: Having lived until today in screams of Avici torment, in this human world only, only those words were the one truth.
I am twenty-seven years old this year.

units.source_text: 由於白髮明顯增多，看到我的人，一般都認為我已經四十多歲了。

en.t: Because my white hair has increased noticeably, people who see me generally think I am already over forty.

units.source_text: [1]一種三絃伴奏的傳統說唱藝術。

en.t: [1] A traditional narrative performing art accompanied by the shamisen.
[2] In Japanese, mitsu, meaning honey, is tsumi, meaning sin, read in reverse.

units.source_text: [3]出自梵語，陷入「阿鼻地獄」後的呼喊聲。

en.t: [3] From Sanskrit, the cries uttered after falling into Avici Hell.
